existing_control_cohort_diagnosis.interpretation: Zero actions are explained by the frozen conditions, not by a failed observer. Bars are repeated observations within entries, not independent statistical samples.

limitations: Real entry prices, quantities and opening fees are frozen facts; the three exits are research hypotheses, not a replay of production exit code.
Opening exposure before the last fill and the partial entry candle are unobservable at five-minute resolution; survival over that boundary is not proven by this model.
Actual full-inventory diagnostics stop at the first reduction or fixed horizon. Counterfactual exits can continue beyond the real close; do not interpret that as actual achievable profit.
Planned stop is not proof of exchange protection placement. Historical venue filters, liquidity and funding are not validated; outputs are not release eligible.
Opening fees are actual; closing costs are assumed. Account settlement is separately recorded as-of, never treated as a matched shadow uplift baseline.
ReplayPolicy capital/sizing defaults do not resize the actual filled position or change live account settings.
Terminal research evidence remains frozen; a settlement arriving later is not silently substituted into the original snapshot.
Control source archive mismatch is recorded UNCOVERED, never zero triggers; a new audit version is required to explicitly reassess that failed audit.
No automatic publication of candidate signals, trade permissions, risk changes or promotion to trading.
